question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**limited**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence discusses how human activities contribute to landslides.
 
• The phrase "including but not..." suggests that the list is not exhaustive.
 
• "**Limited**" fits well in the blank as it correctly conveys the idea that human activities contributing to landslides are not restricted to just agriculture and building.
 
• Other options ("**named**", "**freed**", "**escaped**") do not logically fit the context of restriction or extent.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Named (नामित): "Named" means identified or labeled, which does not fit the phrase "including but not..."
 
• Freed (मुक्त किया गया): "Freed" means released, which does not match the context of restriction.
 
• Escaped (भाग निकला): "Escaped" means evaded or avoided, which does not logically fit the sentence.
